examples.en: It takes a lot of self-discipline to go jogging in winter.
examples.zh: 在冬天跑步是需要很大的自律力的。

examples.en: Under such a rule, students still have some freedom, and they learn how to improve self-discipline and live with new technologies.
examples.zh: 在这样的规定下，学生仍有一些自由，他们学会如何提高自律能力和与新技术共处。

examples.en: It's up to your own self-discipline—how much efforts you put into study.
examples.zh: 这取决于你自己的自律程度——你在学习上投入了多少努力。
